completion_data.completion_summary: Landed R2 (over a dense Archimedean duration group a task frame is static iff it has a uniform dwell time, hence every finite-carrier frame over such an order is static; core chop stated at [Archimedean D] only, density used once) and R1 (ValidIn fc φ ↔ ValidDetIn fc φ at every class via the shift-set round trip plus the new helper ShiftSet.frame_deterministic) as three new sorry-free modules with compiled sharpness witnesses for both R2 hypotheses; lake build --wfail green, all module invariants pass, four headlines pinned in C14 and rowed in docs/theorem-index.md.

memory_candidates.content: In BimodalLogic, `fun _ _ _ => Iff.rfl` does not close `S.frame.TaskRel w d u ↔ u = S.sh w d` for a ShiftSet (the fibre is presented through TaskFrame.reflect); use `S.fibre_taskRel w d u`. Likewise ofReflective-built frames are read through `FrameOver.ofReflective_taskRel`, never by unfolding.

`SuccOrder ℤ` is not in scope from FormalSystem.Semantics.TaskFrame's closure; import `Mathlib.Data.Int.SuccPred` (as Metalogic/Soundness.lean does) and recover it on `(TemporalOrder.of ℤ).carrier` with `inferInstanceAs (SuccOrder ℤ)`.

check-module-invariants.sh's C5 treats any all-capitalized dotted `FormalSystem.*` name in docs as a module path; a theorem-index row for a declaration in a namespace that is not a module (e.g. FormalSystem.Semantics.FrameOver.foo) needs an entry in scripts/module-invariants-allowlist.txt, which documents exactly that exemption class. Also: never pass --help to that script; it starts a full run.

reflection.what_worked: Transcribing the research appendix verbatim after it had been re-elaborated against the live tree: two of three modules compiled first time under --wfail, and the one failure was a missing instance import.
reflection.what_was_hard: The repository's gates are many and opinionated (C5 module-path regex vs namespace names, C14 twin heredocs, generated inventory blocks, generated root); each needed one careful read of the script rather than guessing.
reflection.what_was_missed: A plan-file edit script used a substring that also occurred inside prose and briefly duplicated the plan; caught by the heading grep and reconstructed before commit. Anchor edit scripts on unique line-start patterns.
reflection.successes: Every acceptance criterion in the task description met: lake build --wfail green, lean_verify standard axioms only, check-module-invariants.sh all pass, mk_all --check exit 0, ShiftSet.lean untouched.
